metadata.title: CI Pipeline - Lint, Tests, and Smoke E2E

story.iWant: a robust CI pipeline with linting, unit tests, and smoke E2E tests on every PR and commit
story.soThat: code quality is enforced, regressions are caught early, and deployments are reliable
story.tasks: - Extend existing CI workflow with coverage and optimizations - Add gitleaks job for secrets scanning - Add smoke E2E job with Docker Compose and Playwright/curl - Enable branch protection on main - Update README with CI badge and local test instructions

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: - CI runs on push/PR with lint, unit tests, secrets scan, smoke E2E - All jobs pass; pipeline completes in <5 minutes - Failed CI blocks merging via branch protection - README updated with CI badge and test instructions

artifacts.code: - .github/workflows/ci.yml - .gitleaks.toml (to be created) - tests/e2e/ (new directory for smoke tests) - apps/api/tests/ (existing unit tests) - apps/web/__tests__/ (existing unit tests)
artifacts.dependencies: - GitHub Actions: actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/setup-python@v5 - Tools: gitleaks, playwright (or curl for smoke tests) - Docker Compose (for E2E environment)

story-context.constraints: - Keep E2E tests minimal (smoke only); full E2E suite can be future story - Pipeline must complete in <5 minutes for fast feedback - Cache dependencies (npm, pip) to speed up jobs - Run jobs in parallel where possible
story-context.interfaces: - CI workflow triggers on push to main and PR events - Smoke E2E verifies: API /healthz returns 200, Web / returns 200, basic login flow - Gitleaks scans all commits in PR for secrets

tests.standards: - ESLint for frontend (Next.js) - Ruff for backend (FastAPI) - Pytest for API unit tests - Vitest for web unit tests - Playwright or curl for smoke E2E
tests.locations: - .github/workflows/ci.yml (all CI jobs) - tests/e2e/smoke.spec.ts (Playwright) or tests/e2e/smoke.sh (bash/curl) - apps/api/tests/test_*.py - apps/web/__tests__/*.test.ts
tests.ideas: - Add coverage reports (Codecov integration) - Store test artifacts (screenshots, logs) on failure - Add performance budget checks in CI - Consider matrix testing (multiple Node/Python versions)
